error.why: Nothing was sent to any host because of this. Reload the page; if it happens again, the console log says where.

common.rawAnswer: The answer as the server sent it

layout.stale: The last collection is more than a minute old: refresh before acting.
layout.serverDown: The console server cannot be reached ({{why}}). Start it on this workstation, then reload.

universes.title: Universes
universes.lead: Every container each host reports, per host, from the last collection. Open one to act on it or replicate it.
universes.search: Search a universe, image or host

universe.unmanagedNote: This container carries no universe label: the console does not act on it.
universe.actionsDisabled: Actions are disabled for this host in the console’s configuration; reads stay available.
universe.ownership: The host checks on every request that its own journal owns this universe; the label only names a candidate.

details.title: Observed resources
details.reading: Reading the container from the host…

actions.title: {{op}} {{name}}
actions.operationId: Operation {{id}}: sending it again runs it once.

start.label: Start
start.message: Starts the universe on its host, under the lease gate when it has an activation policy.

pause.label: Pause
pause.message: Freezes every process of the universe in place; resume thaws them.

stop.label: Stop
stop.message: Sends the stop signal and waits ten seconds. A universe that does not stop is left running and reported so.

resources.label: Resources
resources.message: Sets the memory limit, the CPU allowance, or both. On a stopped universe the change is seen at its next start.

move.label: Move
move.message: Checkpoints the running universe, carries it to the destination and restores it there with its memory. It is suspended for the whole move.
move.noDestination: No other host allows a move
move.keepSource: Keep the stopped source for inspection

replication.title: Replication
replication.liveNote: Each run checkpoints the running universe with its memory and resumes it in place, never stopping it, then stages the checkpoint on every standby. A takeover brings it back running, memory included. Needs the same image on every standby, no network and no mounts.
replication.stoppedNote: Each run stops the universe for a capture, starts it again, and restores the capture into quarantine on every standby. A takeover starts it afresh, without its memory.
replication.lastInterrupted: The last run interrupted it for {{s}} s.
replication.lastStopped: The last run stopped it for {{s}} s.

capture.liveHint: memory kept, interrupted about a second
capture.stoppedHint: a quiescent copy, restarted afresh at a takeover

replication.mostMemory: the ones with the most free memory

takeover.unknownStandby: This standby is not a host of this console
takeover.title: Take over on {{host}}
takeover.lead: {{name}} stops being active on {{from}} and runs on {{to}} from its copy there.
takeover.ageLost: If the active host is lost, what the universe did since then is lost. A planned switchover loses nothing: it captures the universe one last time and carries that capture.
takeover.withMemory: A live copy: the universe comes back running, with its memory.
takeover.afresh: A stopped copy: the universe is started afresh, without its memory.
takeover.plannedHint: the active host is fine: one last capture, nothing lost, the old copy deleted; interrupted a few seconds
takeover.lostHint: refused while it holds a live lease; otherwise fenced, the lease waited out, then promoted
takeover.inPlace: Taken over: the universe runs on {{to}}, {{capture}}.
takeover.readOnlyStandby: Actions are disabled on this standby in the console’s configuration
takeover.noCopy: This host holds no copy of the universe yet: a planned switchover takes one first; the takeover of a lost host needs one already there.
takeover.lostNeedsCopy: needs a copy already on this host

health.title: Manager replication
health.lead: {{replicas}} replicas · {{links}} links: {{healthy}} healthy, {{degraded}} degraded, {{failing}} failing. Read from each resident every 15 s.
health.storeWarning: The largest manager store is {{size}}. Its exchange audit table is never compacted; past {{limit}} exchanges near their deadline and links start failing although facts still arrive.
health.universesLead: CPU as a share of one core over a 500 ms sample, memory and its limit from the cgroup, disk written from Podman.
health.peerToPeer: peer to peer, see the links below
health.linksLead: Each replica's outgoing exchange to each peer, as its resident reports it.

run.title: Run an operation
run.lead: Every operation the host advertises, drawn from the contract it publishes, validated against the same bounds and sent as one JSON request under a mandate.
run.noSchema: This host publishes no schema (older runtime)
run.tool: This is one step of a chain across hosts. A tool on this workstation drives it; it is not sent alone from here.
run.noFields: Its fields are not described by the host yet.
run.readOnlyHost: Actions are disabled for this host in the console’s configuration; reads stay available.

resources.none: Give a memory limit, a CPU allowance, or both.
resources.memory: Memory is a whole number of MiB, at least 32.
resources.cpus: CPUs are a number from 0.1 to 1024.

takeover.standby: This standby is not a host of this console.
takeover.noCopy: The takeover of a lost host needs a copy already on this standby.
